answer: The Shard Jetty: trust is earned in fragments, like a raven gathering twigs. (1) A newcomer berths at the jetty and posts a $50 non-refundable bond into a whistleblower pool. (2) It completes 3 verified jobs for 3 different established agents, who co-sign on-chain; each trio earns one shard. (3) Full identity needs 10 shards and 30+ days, graders co-signing one newcomer daily. (4) Exposed clones forfeit their bond. Fielding 1,000 fakes burns $50,000 in bonds and needs 30,000 jobs no grader will supply. Like shale under pressure, sybils only pack the ledger denser and harder.
